title: Stolen Eggs
wikitext:
Retrieve the chest of stolen turtle eggs from Sergeant Rodrik and deliver them safely to the Gyala Hatchery. {{Quest infobox | name = Stolen Eggs | map = [[Image:Stolen Eggs map.jpg|250px]] | campaign = Factions | region = The Jade Sea | type = Primary | given by = [[Elder Rhea]] | given at = [[Cavalon]] | preceded by = [[Befriending the Luxons]] | followed by = [[Gyala Hatchery]] }} ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Recover the [[Old Chest (Stolen_Eggs)|stolen chest]] of turtle eggs. * Return the chest of turtle eggs to [[Hatchery Keeper Gratian]]. * See [[Endre]] for your reward. ===Reward=== * 4,000 [[Experience]] * 1,250 [[Luxon Faction]] * 150 [[Gold]] * 1 [[Skill Point]] ==Walkthrough== From [[Cavalon]] follow the path on the mission map east then north. The [[Old Chest (Stolen Eggs)|chest]] is located in the southwest corner of [[Maishang Hills]], point 1 on the mission map. [[Sergeant Rodrik]] and the [[Outcast]] crew will start a conversation once you get close, and soon will become hostile and attack. After the fight is over, grab the chest and follow the path marked on the mission map. After crossing the bridge at point 2, you will need to turn almost 180 degrees to the left and take the path heading south. Take the chest to [[Gyala Hatchery (outpost)|Gyala Hatchery]] which is in the southeast corner of the same territory. The [[Kappa]] and [[Naga]] you encounter along this path are quite strong so come prepared. Also as you approach the beach at the end, you will run into a group of Naga which includes [[Stsou Swiftscale]]. The [[Old_Chest_(Stolen_Eggs)|chest]] is a bundle item, which provides no blessing of any kind, but does not interfere with movement speed. ==NPCs== ===Foes=== [[Human]] ([[Kurzick]]) *{{w}} 20 (20) [[Sergeant Rodrik]] Humans ([[Outcast]]) *{{w}} 22 (22) [[Outcast Warrior]] *{{n}} 21 (21) [[Outcast Deathhand]] *{{a}} 22 (22) [[Outcast Assassin]] *{{rt}} 23 (23) [[Bandit Leader]] ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Elder Rhea :''"You have proven yourself a capable and loyal ally of the Luxons, so it is with confidence that I impart on you this most vital mission. You have, of course, seen how important the great turtles are to us, both as beasts of burden and beasts of war. Unfortunately, a group of bandits have recently attacked one of our supply caravans and stolen a chest of turtle eggs before they could reach the hatchery. Our turtles are very rare, and it is not often that they lay eggs, so every single egg is precious to us. We must track the bandits back to their camp in the '''Maishang Hills''', recover the '''chest of turtle eggs''', and get them to the '''Gyala Hatchery''' before something happens to them. Can you do this for us, ?"'' {{offer dialog |accept = Hang on, little ones! I'll save you! |decline = Have you ever tried pickled turtle eggs? |ask = I have heard that the bandits make their camp in '''Maishang Hills'''. They are sure to have the eggs there. Once you find them, get them back to '''Hatchery Keeper Gratian''' as quickly as you can. }} ===Intermediate dialogue=== :'''Bandit Leader''': ''"You're late."'' :'''Sergeant Rodrik''': ''"We had some...troubles. Do you have the item?"'' :'''Bandit Leader''': ''"Yes. Do you have the gold?"'' :'''Sergeant Rodrik''': ''"Of course. It's all there, but count it if you must. With these eggs destroyed and our upcoming attack on..."'' :'''Bandit Leader''': ''"Quiet fool! I think we have company."'' {{bug|This dialogue loops indefinitely if Sergeant Rodrik or the Outcasts aren't attacked.}} ;Hatchery Keeper Gratian :''"The stolen eggs! What a relief... I can't bear to think of what would have happened to these little guys if you hadn't found them! Listen, if you have the time, head into the hatchery. There is a new caravan heading out, and I am sure they would be happy to have some additional guards.
My little babies. Shhh...don't worry now. Let me know when you are ready {{sic|missing punctuation between "ready" and "Argo"}} Argo is waiting."'' :{{yes|ingame}} '''Let's go.''' ::''When you are ready, I will let you enter Gyala Hatchery.'' ::{{yes|ingame}} '''I am ready.''' :::''Your entire party is about to be moved to the next area. Make sure all party members are ready first. Do you wish to continue?'' :::{{yes|ingame}} '''Yes''' (sent to [[Stolen Eggs (cinematic)]]) :::{{no|ingame}} '''No.''' ::{{no|ingame}} '''Not right now.''' ===Reward dialogue=== ;Endre :''"So you are the ones coming along with us. Argo told me about you. You may have beaten the three clans at the Convocation, but I was not witness to it. Until I see you fight with my own eyes, your strength is nothing to me...Words on the wind. If we make it to the end of this alive, then your reputation with myself, and the rest of the Luxons, will be solid as this sea of jade."'' ==Notes== *[[Stsou Swiftscale]] will not spawn if the quest [[Attack the Kurzicks!]] is active. * It is possible to run this quest without attacking any foes.
